name: Option row
summary: The repeatable option/answer row — one bordered row with an inside drag handle, a borderless counted textarea, an optional correct toggle and per-option image, and a floating hover delete (SETTINGS-20/34/23/39).
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-option-row> — the repeatable option/answer row, composed from DS primitives. Its UNIVERSAL CORE (SETTINGS-34): the ROW carries the ONE border (radius 8) — the text field inside is a BORDERLESS counted textarea (no box-in-a-box / double border); the drag handle is the FIRST child INSIDE that border (not a column to its left); the delete floats just OUTSIDE the top-right, shown ONLY on hover and disabled at the minimum item count (SETTINGS-23). Per-type extras compose in only when the type has them — a correct-answer checkbox (scored types) and the per-option image control (SETTINGS-22). The drag handle appears only when order matters (`orderable`); an unordered set is not numbered (SETTINGS-39). Reuses <aha-counted-textarea borderless>, <aha-checkbox> and <aha-image-action-button>. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens.
codeNote: A composite element that COMPOSES DS leaves (never re-implements them): the borderless CountedTextarea, the Checkbox, the ImageActionButton. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: the ONE border — 1px #E3E3E3, radius 8; field inside is borderless (no double border)

spec.label: Drag handle
spec.value: system-drag, FIRST child inside the border; shown only when order matters (orderable)

spec.label: Text
spec.value: borderless counted textarea — focus-only counter, wraps, scrolls beyond ~4 lines (SETTINGS-21)

spec.label: Correct
spec.value: optional leading checkbox (correctable) — scored types only

spec.label: Image
spec.value: optional per-option ImageActionButton (image) — the full state set (SETTINGS-22)

spec.label: Delete
spec.value: floats just OUTSIDE the top-right, hover-only, disabled at min (candelete=false)

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: focus-within → #6A1EBB row border + ring (on the one persistent border)

props.name: maxlength
props.desc: Character cap — turns the focus-only counter on

props.name: orderable
props.desc: Show the drag handle (order carries meaning) — omit for an unordered set (SETTINGS-39)

props.name: correctable
props.desc: Show the leading correct-answer checkbox (scored types)

props.name: correct
props.desc: Whether this option is marked correct

props.name: imagesrc
props.desc: The image thumbnail URL when filled

props.name: candelete
props.desc: false disables the delete at the minimum item count

props.name: input / correct-change / delete
props.desc: Composed events; image-add/change/edit/delete are forwarded from the image control

whenToUse.when: a slide type's option / answer list — the "Items" list (SETTINGS-20)
a repeatable COMPOSITE item with its own body of fields (a Question)

opinion.note: The row is the one border; the field inside is borderless — never a box-in-a-box (SETTINGS-34). The drag handle lives INSIDE the border and only when order matters (SETTINGS-39). The delete is hover-only and disables (not hides) at the minimum count (SETTINGS-23). No "X of Y" counter — the +Add disables at max and delete at min (SETTINGS-36).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab OptionRow control mapped into the DS. It composes the DS borderless field, checkbox and image control into the reference option-row anatomy (SETTINGS-20/34/23/39).
